localizations.whatsNew:
• Introducing Groups (Beta) for badminton, table tennis, tennis and pickleball. Invite friends, organize activities, arrange matches, and view group results and leaderboards.
• Improved scoreboard layouts on iPhone and iPad.
• Tool sounds and voice announcements now work in Silent mode, with playback controlled by the app’s sound and voice settings. Adjust the volume using your device’s volume buttons.
• Refined match setup, membership details and translations.
• Improved live score syncing and overall stability.

• 新增「小组」功能（试用），支持羽毛球、乒乓球、网球和匹克球。邀请好友、组织活动、安排对阵，集中查看赛果与排行榜。
• 优化 iPhone 和 iPad 上的计分板布局。
• 工具音效和语音播报支持在手机静音模式下播放，仍由应用内开关控制，可通过音量键调节声音大小。
• 改进开赛设置、会员信息展示和多语言文案。
• 提升实时比分同步稳定性，修复已知问题。
